**Beta.** HACS only offers it if you enable beta versions for Awtrix Studio (⋮ → Redownload → Show beta versions).

### New since 0.12.0b1
- **Choose the fonts of a layout.** Under the layout, pick the **value font** among the legible 8-pixel fonts: bold (the default), light, or one of the wide ones, which read best but only fit short values next to an icon. For **Title and value** and **Two entities**, pick the **title** or **lines** font too: light (the default) or bold. The preview shows each font as the clock draws it.

### Layouts on the TC002 (from 0.12.0b1)
On a TC002 running AWTRIX NG, a simple app can use the whole 52 × 16 screen, one LED per pixel, instead of one line at double size: **Value**, **Title and value**, **Value and progress bar**, or **Two entities, one per line**. The icon is optional, and a gallery icon is drawn at 16 × 16.

Existing apps keep working as they are: they stay on one line until you pick a layout.
